audit.base_arxiv_limitation: Calendar-month/category arXiv discovery is broad but not exhaustive; multiple 2024-H1 month/category slices reached max_results=2000. Supplemental paper gap-fill is restricted to load-bearing material explicitly confirmed absent from the normalized base index.
audit.method: Period-specific primary-source coverage audit across frontier/multimodal/long-context models, open-weight/open-training stacks, sparse/hybrid and small/on-device architectures, RAG/tool/action systems, generative media, inference/training efficiency, safety/control/interpretability, and exact lifecycle/availability boundaries.
base_feed_satisfies: Sora / Video generation models as world simulators (2024-02-15)
audit.base_feed_note: These three OpenAI events are already preserved as canonical official-feed records from the base RSS snapshot. Direct openai.com page fetching returns HTTP 403 to the deterministic supplemental collector, so redundant supplemental copies are intentionally omitted rather than weakening fail-closed collection.
